dedicated.name: Gelidus's Glacial Bride

why_by_stat.Resilience: Reduces incoming Critical Damage 1%-for-1%, helping Gelidus survive Critical Hits more easily.

dedicated.story:
"I shall name it the Glacial Bride — as a tribute to you."

In his quest for the magic mirror, Gelidus found himself locked in an evenly matched duel against Lania — a clash that ultimately fostered deep connection between them. Their hostility eventually faded, giving way to a bond of mutual understanding. When news of war in his homeland compelled Gelidus to depart, Lania gifted him with a massive axe capable of freezing anything it touched. Gelidus christened his new weapon the "Glacial Bride" and set off on his journey back home.

lore:
Born in a remote territory of the Asgar continent, Gelidus rose to prominence as a great warrior during an age of ceaseless battles against monsters.
But his wild and fierce nature was a source of countless troubles.
When a continent-wide power struggle spread throughout Asgar and eventually reached Gelidus's homeland, the lord of the region grew anxious that Gelidus might become a focal point of the rising conflict.
As a pretext to send him away, the lord gave Gelidus a mission: gather the Shards of Destruction, and don't return until the task is complete.
Gelidus departed on his journey, and he soon heard rumors of a mysterious mirror in the palace of the Ice Queen with the power to transport the user anywhere they desired.
If the rumors were true, it would make Gelidus's mission to collect the Shards of Destruction that much easier, so he headed for the Blizzard Plains.
This is how the man as fiery as the blazing sun came to meet a queen who was colder than ice.
Having fallen in love with her at first sight, Gelidus showered Queen Lania with affection, and even the queen gradually opened her heart to his bold advances. Before long, their love for each other deepened to the point that she gave him a dragon's relic known as the "Glacial Bride."
But Gelidus was still beholden to his lord's command to collect the Shards of Destruction.
He resolved to complete his task as quickly as possible then return to his beloved's side to spend the rest of their lives together.
And so, Gelidus left Lania, unaware that his love was pregnant.
